breakeven_cost_bps.note: round-trip cost at which a variant's mean return reaches zero

mechanism: SIGNAL WITH INVERTED SIGN. Gross returns are negative and stay negative after removing market exposure (residual Sharpe -0.34, market explains only 20%). The rules carry predictive content pointing the wrong way. Note this is still a fitted direction chosen after the fact — the opposite rules must be pre-registered and tested separately.

null_calibration.note: Null datasets reuse the real bar returns in random order: same distribution, no serial structure. If the observed value sits inside this spread it is an artefact of the measurement, not a property of the market.
